The invoice bills qty 4 for DOC-USB, but the PO ordered 10 and the GRN received 10. The discrepancy is PO_ALREADY_BILLED - the invoice bills fewer units than ordered/received. This is a quantity issue (under-billing), which per the rules is a hold_for_review. The bank IBAN on the invoice is masked (******************4302) but the vendor master shows US11NWND00000987654302 ending in 4302, so it matches.

The route chosen by the rules is hold_for_review. The discrepancy list is not empty (PO_ALREADY_BILLED), so approve_for_payment is not appropriate. This is a quantity issue, so hold_for_review is correct.

result.email_draft:
Subject: Invoice NW-8024 on Hold – PO-2026-1024

Dear Accounts Receivable Team,

Our reference: PO-2026-1024

Invoice NW-8024, dated October 5, 2026, totaling USD 380.00, is currently on hold due to a discrepancy concerning item DOC-USB.

Our records indicate that all 10 units ordered and received under PO-2026-1024 were already billed on invoice NW-7024. However, invoice NW-8024 bills an additional 4 units. Please confirm why this invoice bills only 4 of the 10 USB-C docking stations ordered and received under the purchase order, and clarify the relationship between these quantities and the prior invoice.

Please issue a credit note or a corrected invoice, as appropriate.

Kind regards,
